This looks like a partly eaten breakfast tray. I estimated each item by eye, so the figures are rough.

| Item | Mass (g) | Energy (kcal) |
|---|---|---|
| Banana, with peel on | 120 edible | 105 |
| Yogurt cup | 100 | 90 |
| Toast on the left plate, partly eaten, with spread | 35 | 100 |
| Toast on the right plate, about 1.5 slices, with Vegemite | 50 | 130 |
| Egg | 50 | 80 |
| Avocado, about half | 60 | 100 |
| Sugar sachets, probably unused | 0 | 0 |

The coffee mug appears to be empty, so I counted nothing for it.

The totals come to about 605 kcal and about 415 g.
